Auth.//: TASK-042: validates the JWTs the browser sends to this Gateway's GraphQL and REST surfaces - a user token minted by /login, not the machine token the ServiceClient section below is about. Authority is deliberately unset: the Auth Service publishes a JWKS document but no OpenID discovery document, so the issuer is pinned here instead of being learned from metadata. Port 5091 is the Auth Service's local profile; TASK-047 replaces it with the compose service address.

Cors.//: TASK-042: the frontend's Vite dev-server origin. TASK-047 replaces this with the compose frontend address.

RabbitMq.//: TASK-043: dedicated vhost, least-privilege user scoped to readings.stored.gateway (consume only).

ServiceClient.//: The gateway-ingestor machine client this Gateway authenticates itself with (TASK-026) when calling the Ingestor/Processor admin APIs - the same client TASK-017/TASK-021 already granted ingestion:admin. Port 5091 is the Auth Service's local profile; TASK-047 replaces it with the compose service address.

Services.//: Base addresses of the admin APIs this Gateway proxies (TASK-026). Local dev profiles; TASK-047 replaces both with compose service addresses.
